name: t_jira_stale_days
description: Jira open item with no update for this many days is stale

name: t_ip_stale_days
description: In-progress item with no update (or no linked code activity) for this many days is stale

name: t_throughput_drop
description: Alert when the last complete week is below this fraction of the average of the 4 weeks before it

name: t_wip_per_person
description: In-progress items per person above this count is over the limit

name: t_first_review_days
description: First review should arrive within this many days

name: t_mr_size_lines
description: Changed lines (excluding lockfiles and generated files) above this are too large

name: t_open_stale_days
description: Open change with no activity for this many days is stale; a draft older than this is stale

name: t_freshness_days
description: As-of timestamp older than this is flagged stale

name: t_min_n
description: A rate for a person is shown only when its denominator is at least this

name: t_c7_include_drafts
description: 1 counts draft changes in C7 (the criteria default: C7 if open: not stale); 0 leaves drafts to C8 only
